steps.why: Click the + button to create a new Purchase Invoice
Open the Supplier field to select Suno
Supplier dropdown is open; type to filter for Suno
Select existing supplier 'Suno' from the dropdown suggestions
Supplier appears set to Suno; next open the Date field to change it to 2026-06-26
The date field's day segment is active in DD/MM/YYYY format, so typing 26, 06 and 2026 should set the date to 26/06/2026.
The typed date did not register (field still shows 19/09/2026), so I'll use the calendar picker instead and go back one month toward June 2026.
The calendar is showing August 2026. Clicking the up arrow moves back a month, toward June 2026, so I can then pick the 26th.
The calendar shows July 2026; go back one more month to June 2026, then pick the 26th.
The date field shows 19/06/2026 and the calendar is on June 2026, so I'm clicking the 26th to set the invoice date to 2026-06-26.
Date field already shows 26/06/2026; click an empty area of the form header to close the date picker before adding the item row.
Supplier (Suno) and date (Jun 26, 2026) are set; add an item row next.
Item field is focused; enter the expense item name
Item text is typed but no suggestion dropdown is visible; clicking the Item field should open the suggestions so I can pick the existing 'AI Models & API' item.
Select 'AI Models & API' from the item dropdown
The item row appears to show 'AI Models & API', but the rate is still $0.00. I'm clicking the Rate cell so I can enter the amount of 10.00.
Rate field is focused with 0.00 selected; enter the invoice amount as the rate
Rate field shows 10.00 but the amount is still $0.00; tabbing out commits the rate so the amount and totals recalculate
Supplier Suno, date Jun 26 2026, item AI Mode… qty 1, rate $10.00 are all filled; save the draft before submitting.
Confirm the save dialog so the new Purchase Invoice (Suno, Jun 26 2026, $10.00) is saved before submitting
Invoice is saved with Suno, Jun 26 2026, AI Models item, qty 1, rate $10.00 but still shows Not Submitted; clicking Submit.
Confirm the submit dialog for PINV-1036 (supplier Suno, date Jun 26 2026, $10.00) by clicking Yes
Create a new Purchase Invoice with the + button
Open the Supplier field to enter 'Anthropic, PBC'
Select supplier 'Anthropic, PBC' from the open dropdown
Supplier is set; now open the Date field to change it to 2026-05-30
The day segment of the date field is focused. In dd/mm/yyyy order this should enter 30/05/2026, since the segments auto-advance.
The typed date did not apply (the field still shows 19/09/2026), so I'll use the calendar instead. This goes back one month, toward May 2026.
The typed date did not apply, and the calendar is showing August 2026. The up arrow moves back one month, so I'm stepping toward May 2026 to pick the 30th.
Calendar shows July 2026; go back one more month toward May 2026 (target date 30/05/2026).
Each up-arrow click moved the calendar back one month (Sep→Jun); one more click reaches May 2026.
The calendar already shows May 2026, so clicking 30 sets the invoice date to 30/05/2026 instead of repeatedly clicking the month arrow.
Date is now 30/05/2026; next add an item row (this should also close the date picker).
Item field is focused; type the expense item name to search for it
The item text is typed but no suggestion dropdown is visible. Clicking the item field should open the list so I can pick 'AI Models & API'.
Select 'AI Models & API' from the item dropdown to set the item on row 1.
Item appears set to 'AI Models & API'; now click the Rate field to enter 200.00
Rate field is focused with 0.00 selected; enter the invoice amount as rate
Commit the typed rate 200.00 so the amount and totals update before saving.
Supplier, date, item, quantity 1 and rate $200.00 are all filled in; save the draft before submitting
Confirm the save dialog for the new Purchase Invoice; supplier Anthropic, PBC, date May 30 2026 and a $200.00 item row are all filled in
Invoice is saved (PINV-1037) but still Not Submitted; click Submit
The submit confirmation for PINV-1037 is open, and the supplier (Anthropic, PBC), date (May 30, 2026) and amount ($200.00) all match, so click Yes to submit.
